scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What are you doing here?
That's right, I'm waiting for a strong adventurer to satisfy my curiosity!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你在这里做什么？
没错，我正在等一位实力强大的冒险者，来满足我的好奇心！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
If you reach level 175, you will be my destined opponent-��
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
等你达到175级，就会成为我命中注定的对手——

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I think I've made a great discovery, so why don't you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我好像有了重大发现，要不要跟我一起去看看？

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出发吧！

scripts.text: Please explain it.
scripts.translation: 说来听听

scripts.text: What I found
scripts.translation: 你发现了什么？

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
This is my bae!
You're gonna jump into the abyss with me! I can't help But L-O-V-E you.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
这可是我的宝贝！
你要和我一起跳进深渊！我简直爱死你了。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As you know, I'm a good court wizard, right?
A genius wizard who can do this and that on dimension!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你知道的，我可是优秀的宫廷魔法师，对吧？
我是天才魔法师，能在各个维度施展各种法术！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
There was a report of strange magical power near central castle of Glast Heim.
I came here to investigate and found it.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
有人报告说，格拉斯特海姆中央城堡附近出现了奇怪的魔力。
我来调查，结果真的发现了异常。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
A week crack of dimension!
You know, this genius wizard is good at connecting the crack of dimensions.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
是一道微弱的次元裂缝！
你知道的，我这位天才魔法师最擅长连接次元裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
So I forced the connection and went in....
A piece of time that has stopped in the flow.... Hmmm... It's so hard to explain..
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
于是我强行打通裂缝，走了进去...
那里是一段停滞在时间洪流中的时空...嗯...真难解释...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Anyway, the flood of creatures trapped for a long time came to me like waves!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
总之，被困在里面很久的魔物如潮水般向我涌来！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I almost D - i - e - d there.
So I'm looking for adventurers to join me on this expedition.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我差点就死在里面。
所以我正在找冒险者，和我一起去探险。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Right, there's no mission here, but curiosity follows discovery!
You noticed before I told you there were a few things I wanted to do with you, My - Darling -.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
对，这里没什么任务可做，但发现总能勾起好奇心！
在我开口之前，你就看出来了吧？我有几件事想和你一起做，亲——爱——的。

scripts.text: An Empty Thing
scripts.translation: 空无一物

scripts.text: A Thing with High Freezing Point
scripts.translation: 凝固点很高的东西

scripts.text: A Thing Like A Mirror
scripts.translation: 像镜子一样的东西

scripts.text: Well, I'm okay.
scripts.translation: 我没事

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Beyond the cracks of this dimension, there are Empty Things..
^0000FFContaminated Raydric^000000 and ^0000FFContaminated Raydric Archer^000000...
Contamination
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
在这个次元裂缝的另一边，有一些“空无一物”...
^0000FF被污染的幽灵剑士^000000和^0000FF被污染的幽灵弓箭手^000000...
它们都受到了污染。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^0000FF20 Contaminated Raydrics^000000,
^0000FF20 Contaminated Raydric Archers^000000!! Defeat them and come back. Then this genius wizard will study it.
What do you think, bae?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^0000FF被污染的幽灵剑士20只^000000，
还有^0000FF被污染的幽灵弓箭手20只^000000！打倒它们再回来，我这位天才魔法师要好好研究一番。
怎么样，宝贝？

scripts.text: That's not hard.
scripts.translation: 这点小事难不倒我

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
If you're busy, you can't help me.
But honey, please help me when You - Have - Spare - Time - !
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你要是忙，就没法帮我了。
亲爱的，有空的时候——一定——要——来——帮——我——哦！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I asked you too much today, Sweetie.
Instead, you're sharing another new discovery tomorrow. O - K - A - Y -?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
今天麻烦你太多了，亲爱的。
明天我再告诉你一个新发现，好——吗——？

scripts.text:
^4d4dff - You can take this mission again. Speak to Mage Nillem once again to accept it. - ^000000
[Nillem]
That's my baby!
It's hard to see the impact there because of the strange magic.
If you finish the quest, let's get out of there first And - Then Check - !
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff - 你可以再次接受此任务。再次与魔法师尼勒姆交谈即可接取。 - ^000000
[尼勒姆]
这才是我的宝贝！
那里的魔力很奇怪，影响难以看清。
任务完成后，我们先离开那里，再——仔——细——检——查！

^4d4dff - You can take this mission again. Speak to Mage Nillem once again to accept it. - ^000000

scripts.translation:

[尼勒姆]

^0000FF被污染的幽灵弓箭手20只^000000。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff - You can take this mission again. Speak to Mage Nillem once again to accept it. - ^000000
[Nillem]
Ha~ It's so obvious out here. Could you please show me your... weapon and... armor? Hmm...
Hmmm!!
Haha, what a discovery of the century!
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff - 你可以再次接受此任务。再次与魔法师尼勒姆交谈即可接取。 - ^000000
[尼勒姆]
哈~在外面看得真清楚。能让我看看你的...武器和...盔甲吗？嗯...
嗯！！
哈哈，真是本世纪的大发现！

次元裂缝的另一边，有一对彼此映照的东西。
^0000FF冰幽灵^000000和^0000FF火幽灵^000000...
它们看起来截然不同，但次元裂缝实在神秘莫测。

好啦，好啦，亲爱的，你说得对。
累了就休息一下。
别——勉——强——自——己——！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, my sweetheart, you're so mean today.
Nillem is saaaad. *Tears*
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哎呀，亲爱的，你今天真无情。
尼勒姆好伤心。*落泪*

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Woo-hoo! I'm so excited whenever I come here!
I love this bleakness!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇哦！每次来这里我都兴奋不已！
我最喜欢这里的荒凉气氛了！

scripts.text: Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation: 离开这里吧！

scripts.text: I'd like to look around.
scripts.translation: 我想再四处看看

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
See you!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
回头见！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Sure!
Let's - Go - Out - Side - !
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
当然！
我——们——到——外——面——去——！

scripts.text:
[Lily]
...?
...well, I don't think the guards will let you in...
scripts.translation:
[莉莉]
...？
...我想卫兵不会让你进去...

scripts.text:
[Lily]
If you are qualified to enter the 3rd floor of Nogg Road, would you accept a quest?
We need a lot of work.
The guards said level 175 is enough...
scripts.translation:
[莉莉]
如果你有资格进入诺格路三楼，愿意接个任务吗？
我们有很多事情要做。
卫兵说达到175级就行...

scripts.text:
[Lily]
Friendly adventurer, would you mind helping us with the research for our conference report?
Only an adventurer's eye is the only way for us to live.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉]
热心的冒险者，你愿意帮我们收集资料，完成会议报告吗？
只有冒险者的亲身观察才能帮上我们的忙。

scripts.text: Listen to the request
scripts.translation: 听听委托内容

scripts.text: Suspicious...
scripts.translation: 听起来很可疑...

scripts.text: Reject
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Lily]
Generous adventurer! Thank you.
The request is on the 3rd floor of Nogg Road, a place I can't enter yet, but the conference wants a report...
scripts.translation:
[莉莉]
慷慨的冒险者，谢谢你！
委托在诺格路三楼。我现在还进不去，但会议需要一份报告...

scripts.text: Dealer that caused abnormal evolution
scripts.translation: 引发异常进化的魔物

scripts.text: Eradicate the nightmare that became a reality
scripts.translation: 消灭化为现实的梦魇

scripts.text: Check density
scripts.translation: 调查密度

scripts.text: Small things crumbling
scripts.translation: 崩解的小东西

scripts.text: Next time
scripts.translation: 下次再说

scripts.text:
[Lily]
Our doctor said that monsters change their characteristics and appearance when they live in different places...
Dr. and me too... Because combat isn't my major.
scripts.translation:
